summary.caption: An anime illustration in a sunlit room: Aria stands on the left and gently pats the head of seated Noah on the right. Noah looks up and smiles. Medium two-shot, soft daylight.

items.label: character
items.caption: Aria, an adult woman with long silver hair and blue eyes, wearing a white blouse and dark blue skirt. Standing on the left, smiling warmly, her right hand extended toward Noah's head as she pats it.

items.label: character
items.caption: Noah, an adult man with short black hair and brown eyes, wearing a black shirt and gray trousers. Seated to the right, looking up toward Aria with a relaxed smile as he receives the head pat.
